mike: Heads-up: aiming to publish the customer release post Thu 09:00am PT. Need final changelog URL, live docs link, canary timing, one-line benchmark hero, and partner embargo. @sara @yang

sara: Changelog ready at https://redwood.in/changelog/v1.8.2. I'll append UTMs before publish (utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=v1_8_2). No legal holds.

yang: Docs will go live Wed 8:30pm PT at https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.8.2. Quick highlight for header: "Improved batching and lower latency for long-context workloads."

mike: Can we get a 20-word headline and 140-char social copy by Wed EOD? Sales wants CTAs to route trial leads to Dedicated-interest.

yang: Done on CTAs 1 will add the tracking slug on the blog CTA. For canary: Wed 10:00pm PT start; 10% for 45m, 40% for 90m, final flip Thu 08:30am PT if green.

sara: Ops note: new quant profile behind ff_quant_v1_8_2. Runbook snippet: ```bash
# start canary
redwoodctl rollout start --release=v1.8.2 --canary=10 --monitor=45m
# toggle quant in canary
redwoodctl feature toggle ff_quant_v1_8_2 --on --env=canary
# rollback
redwoodctl rollout rollback --release=v1.8.2
```

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: Wed 2024-07-24T22:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall and #release-health.

mike: Benchmark hero for social: "Faster long-context inference and smoother latency under load." Use full numbers in blog body (yang/sara will provide). Partner embargo: Thu 8:45am PT. Marketing to finalize copy Wed 6pm PT and schedule Thu 09:00am PT.

yang: I'll drop the detailed benchmark numbers and the webinar slide by Wed 4pm PT.

sara: I'll post the final changelog URL with UTMs here after merge. Will also publish canary health checks to #release-health when it starts.

mike: Great 1 action items: Sara 1 merge + post changelog with UTMs; Yang 1 publish docs + benchmark slide; Marketing 1 finalize and schedule. Preflight checklist here Wed 7pm PT. :rocket:
